name: ZCH_DEDUP_HEADERS_B
description: The ZCH_DEDUP_HEADERS table stores deduplication request header information. One master record for one object type can only created once in one workspace.

columns.name: DEDUP_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Primary key

columns.name: DEDUP_REQ_SOURCE
columns.description: The creation source of the merge request, such as user created, bulk import

columns.name: REVIEW_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate that the record needs to be reviewed by data steward

columns.name: REVIEWED_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate that the record is reviewed by data steward

columns.name: RULE_BASED_MASTER_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate the master is set by rules

columns.name: PROCESSED_USER_ID
columns.description: The person who processed the request

columns.name: PROCESSED_DATE
columns.description: The date the request is submitted

columns.name: MASTER_ID
columns.description: The survivor Id for the deduplication request.

columns.name: DEDUP_REQ_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the request.

columns.name: DEDUP_REQ_NUMBER
columns.description: Request Number

columns.name: OBJ_NAME
columns.description: Name of the object to be processed by duplicate resolution.

columns.name: OBJ_DEF
columns.description: Definition of the object to be processed by duplicate resolution.

columns.name: DEDUP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Same party merge or party site merge.

columns.name: DEDUP_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Merge reason

columns.name: ASSIGNED_USER_ID
columns.description: Assigned to User

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: REQUESTED_USER_ID
columns.description: This column stores the actual user who created the record.

columns.name: CREATION_SRC_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Store the creation source batch Id, for example, the import batch Id or identification batch Id.

columns.name: SEND_NOTIFICATION
columns.description: To indicate whether merge request processing notifications will be sent for this request.

columns.name: LAST_REFRESH_DATE
columns.description: Date when this request was last refreshed based on the latest registry data.
